tiebreakers.description: Tie rule not verified; victory treated as shared.

notes: Official Deluxe base/Rust Belt: 3 VP per final income + completed track sections - 3 VP per issued share; cash has no VP. Base ties share victory. Western US ties: cash, then track, then die roll. Insolvent players cannot win. Other maps and solo maps require separate rule review; choose the map explicitly.
